abstract: For an imaginary quadratic field $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-d_K})$ and a positive-definite $K$-Hermitian space $(V, h_V)$, we prove an all-genus $K$-linear Seifert-Bruhat determinant formula for the parabolic form $H_{\mathrm{par}}$ of any generating tuple in $\mathrm{U}_d(K, h_V)$ with $V^\Pi = 0$ and even dimension $2m$, expressing $(-1)^m \det_K(H_{\mathrm{par}})$ modulo $N_{K/\mathbb{Q}}(K^\times)$ as the product of local Wall invariants $\Theta(C_j)$, together with a Hodge-balance character law whose complex phases cancel on balanced families in all genera. We establish an exact monomial-cycle formula for $G(e,p,d)$, prove a universal Shapiro-Siegel period-image bound $\dim \Phi \le 3m$ for all imprimitive reflection groups and $m(m+1)/2$ for all real reflection groups realizable over $K$ (yielding unconditional uniqueness of $G_{34}$ at $m=4$ across the Shephard-Todd classification), and prove long-reflection character cancellation on $W(G_2)$ and full $96$-element phase cancellation on $G_8$, showing that $G_{31}$ is the unique irreducible order-$2$ reflection group in the $\mathbb{Q}(i)$-Shephard-Todd list admitting non-split balanced families. In $G_{31}$, the $11$-branch family $(R^{10}, C_{34})$ generically immerses an $8$-dimensional locus $\mathcal{Z}_8$ in the $9$-dimensional non-split $\mathbb{Q}(i)$-Weil sixfold domain whose very general fibre has $\mathbb{Q}$-Hodge group $\mathrm{SU}(H_{\mathrm{par}})$ (real form $\mathrm{SU}(3,3)$) and satisfies the all-powers Hodge conjecture. Finally, we establish a $3$-step boundary tower of $\overline{\mathcal{H}}_{0,11}(G_{31}; R^{10}, C_{34})$ dominating $\mathcal{D}_{(2,2)}(\mathbb{Q}(i), \delta=3)$ via exact closure-lattice Möbius inversion on $\mathcal{L}(g_{34,0}) = \{\langle S, g_{34,0} \rangle : S \subseteq R\}$, prove full $\mathfrak{su}(2,2)$ and $\mathfrak{su}(3,3)$ Fox-calculus braid-monodromy Lie generation on connected Hurwitz components $\mathcal{H}^{\circ}(\mathbf{g}_0)$ from explicitly verified index-$2$ unipotent logarithms $N = \log(U) = U - I \in \operatorname{Lie}(\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{mono}}^{\circ})$, and combine exact Möbius volumes in $G_{29}$ and $G_{24}$ with discriminant-cancelling stabilization $B \times \bar{E}_K^{|p-q|}$ to prove the all-powers Hodge conjecture for generic (or full-$\mathrm{GU}(p,q)$) abelian varieties of signatures $(2,1)$, $(3,1)$, and $(3,2)$ over $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ and $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-7})$.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: v3 substantially expands the paper with three new theorems (Theorems 3.2, 4.3, and 4.4), an exact Fox-calculus unipotent-logarithm braid-monodromy Lie-algebra engine (braid_monodromy_lie.py), and exact closure-lattice Mobius-inverted generating volumes on L(g_{34,0}) and L(g_{33,0}) in supplement.zip: (1) Theorem 3.2 (Shapiro-Siegel Universal Period-Image Bound Across the Shephard-Todd Classification in All Genera gamma >= 0): Using Shapiro's Lemma V = Ind_{H_1}^G(psi_1) on the index-d line stabilizer H_1 = Stab_G(K e_1) = {diag(z_1, g') in G(e, p, d) : z_1 in mu_e, g' in G(e, 1, d-1)} of every imprimitive reflection group G(e, p, d) (d >= 2, gamma >= 0), the explicit multiplicity-space isomorphism Hom_G(\overline{V}, H^1(Y_t, K)) = Hom_{H_1}(\overline{psi_1}, H^1(Y_t, K)) = H^1(Y_t / ker(psi_1), K)_{psi_1} (where Y_t / ker(psi_1) -> X_t = Y_t / H_1 is a cyclic mu_{e_1}-cover), and the monomial-cycle codimension identity k(C_j) = d - s_j + b_j from Theorem 2.4(1), we prove that Riemann-Hurwitz on the degree-d quotient curve X_t = Y_t / H_1 -> Sigma_gamma collapses identically to the rank-independent equation 2 g(X_t) - 2 + sum_j b_j = 2m, forcing the universal period-image bound dim Phi(H_{gamma, r}(G(e, p, d))) <= 3 g(X_t) - 3 + sum_j b_j = 3m - (1/2) sum_j b_j <= 3m < m^2 (m >= 4). Combined with the Siegel bound m(m+1)/2 < m^2 (m >= 2) for all real reflection groups G subset O_d(Q, h_0) (including G(1, 1, d) = S_d / W(A_d) = S_{d+1}, G(2, p, d), W(G_2), W(F_4), W(E_6), W(E_7), W(E_8)), this removes the 'non-real primitive' restriction from Theorem 3.1(2), proving that G_34 at m = 4, gamma = 0 is the unique group in the Shephard-Todd classification (realizable over an imaginary quadratic field K) whose period image can reach dimension m^2 for m >= 4. (2) Theorem 4.3 (Mayer-Vietoris Compact-Splitting Criterion, Closure-Lattice Mobius-Inverted Boundary Tower of \overline{H}_{0,11}(G_31; R^{10}, C_34) Dominating D_{(2,2)}(Q(i), delta=3), and Unipotent-Logarithm Braid-Monodromy Lie Generation): Proves the exact toric-rank formula r_toric = d_L + d_R - d - k(g_node) on separating nodes and the general-K Kunneth slant contraction determinant a^2 + d_K * b^2 = N_{K/Q}(a + b*sqrt(-d_K)) > 0, explains via Frobenius-reciprocity node residues and the Baily-Borel projection formula why lambda_{chi_4}^5 = 0 while int lambda_{chi_4}^4 psi_node^1 > 0 and int lambda_{chi_4}^4 psi_{C_34}^1 > 0 on the 5-dimensional d_L = 2 right factor, and resolves proper non-reflection subgroup contributions on mixed-inertia tuples (R^{9-r_L}, C_node, C_34) by enumerating the 10-subgroup closure lattice L(g_{34,0}) = {<S, g_{34,0}> : S subseteq R} (whose 4 coatoms H_3, H_6, H_7, H_8 of orders 768, 1536, 1536, 2304 partition the 60 reflections into 12+12+12+24 = 60). Subtracting the exact H_8 subgroup contribution (reproducing I_{H_8}(C_16) = 75/8, deg_{H_8} = 77760 with induction factor 1/2 on C_16 at d_L=3 and int_{H_8} lambda^4 psi_{C_6} = 375/4, int_{H_8} lambda^4 psi_{C_34} = 75/4, deg_{H_8} = 155520 on C_6 at d_L=2, while all other 12 boundary families have zero proper-subgroup contributions) certifies strictly positive generating volumes I^gen_{G_31}(C_16) = 375/8 > 0 (deg^gen = 349920), int^gen lambda^4 psi_{C_6} = 1125/2 > 0, int^gen lambda^4 psi_{C_34} = 225/2 > 0 (deg^gen = 874800), and I^gen_{G_31}(R^6, C_24, C_33) = 26111553/128 > 0 (deg^gen = 44680896) on the 6-subgroup lattice L(g_{33,0}). Furthermore, braid_monodromy_lie.py certifies via exact Fox-calculus Artin braid unitarity that explicitly verified index-2 unipotent monodromy operators U = I + N in Gamma_mono(g_0) ((U - I)^2 = N^2 = 0, N = log(U) = U - I in Lie(G_mono^0)) and their pure-braid conjugates generate all 15/15 dimensions of su(2, 2) on H^0(g_0) subset H_{0,7}(G_31; R^5, C_14, C_34) and all 35/35 dimensions of su(3, 3) on H^0(g_0) in H_{0,11}(G_31; R^{10}, C_34), H_{0,9}(G_31; R^7, C_14, C_34), and H_{0,8}(G_31; R^6, C_24, C_33). (3) Theorem 4.4 (Unbalanced Signature Stabilization B x \bar{E}_K^{|p-q|}): Extends determinant-stabilization to K in {Q(i), Q(sqrt(-7))} and signature (3,2) fivefolds via Theorem 4.2(1)-(2) cycle inputs, proving the all-powers Hodge conjecture for generic (or full-GU(p,q)) abelian varieties of signatures (2,1), (3,1), and (3,2).
title: All-Genus K-Linear Seifert-Bruhat Determinant Law, the Foster-Greenwood Dichotomy Between G_24, G_29 and G_31, and Hurwitz-Hodge Dominance for Q(i)- and Q(sqrt(-7))-Weil Sixfolds
